title: Analyse on Melanocytic Nevi in Youth
content: : The purpose of the study is to analyse and also to identify structural characteristics reffering to melanocytic nevi, in youth. Using both optical and electronic microscope, could be possible a proper describtion related specificity in melanocytic nevi characteristic. Disease diagnostic and future trends, are important key points in next management directions.As future directions good to mention idea including preventive and prophylactic methods.
